categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC argument handling in src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a minor argument validation quirk where numeric JSON values were accepted instead of strictly requiring strings for createrawtransaction data. As the PR notes, 'createrawtransaction accepts a JSON number as data when its digits form valid hex,' which is an unintended loose type coercion with minimal real-world impact.
